text: Which genes on chromosome 1 are basophil-specific among blood immune cells?
plan: Chromosome: 1 AND Immune cell category (RNA): Basophil / Immune cell enriched
understanding: The question asks for genes located on chromosome 1 that have basophil-specific RNA expression compared to other blood immune cell types.

trail.why: The requirement specifically restricts the search to genes located on chromosome 1.
Basophil specificity is defined by having at least a four-fold higher mRNA level in basophils compared to any other immune cell type ('Immune cell enriched').

requirements.why: This field filters genes by the chromosome on which they reside.
This field defines RNA specificity and distribution across flow-sorted blood immune cell types, including basophils.
